newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Cagamas to issue 1.4 bln rgt notes, bonds.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Cagamas to issue 1.4 bln rgt notes, bonds.

text.p: Malaysia's national mortgage corporation Cagamas Bhd said on Monday it was issuing 1.4 billion ringgit worth of notes and bonds on February 25.
In an announcement, Cagamas said it plans to issue a 150 million ringgit one-month note and a 800 million ringgit note maturing in three months.
It said bids for the notes issues will be accepted on the basis of discount.
Cagamas would also issue a 450 million ringgit Tier-1 fixed-rate bond with a three-year maturity. Bidding for the bonds will be on basis of yield, it said.
The tender closing date is on February 24 at 1130 local time (0330 gmt), Cagamas said.
All notes issues by Cagamas qualify as liquid assets. Malaysian banks need to maintain a portion of their deposits in liquid or mainly government assets.
